notes.title: *IMPORTANT* Price Change Announcement and Game Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43873587/2c2ecb83b421da06b42f206a1f977569609cde3e.png[/img]

[b]Dear Drift Reign Community,[/b]

Firstly, we want to express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has supported Drift Reign in the first three days since our launch on Steam. We are genuinely grateful for your support and the invaluable feedback you have provided.

Today, we are reaching out to you with an important announcement regarding some changes that are taking place, changes that are primarily fueled by your feedback.


Significant Price Adjustment

The biggest news today is about the price of Drift Reign. Many of you shared your thoughts about our initial pricing, and we listened. As a small independent developer, our main goal is to create a game that is both enjoyable and accessible. Balancing these factors, particularly pricing, can be challenging.

Effective immediately, we're making a significant price adjustment. The standard price of Drift Reign has been reduced from $24.99 to just [b]$5.99.[/b] But that's not all - we're keeping the launch discount active. This means that, with the ongoing [b]25% discount[/b], you can now pick up the game for an even more affordable price of [b]$4.49![/b]

We hope that this new pricing will allow more players to join our community and share in the thrills that Drift Reign has to offer.


Bug Fixes and Game Update

We also want to acknowledge your feedback regarding bugs and glitches in the game. We are happy to inform you that we have already patched many of the issues reported at launch. Our team is committed to ensuring that your gaming experience with Drift Reign is as smooth and enjoyable as possible.

Still, we know that there may be more to do. Rest assured, we are dedicated to improving Drift Reign, and we are continuing to work on any remaining issues. Additional updates will be released as necessary and as quickly as possible.

Thank you once again for your continued support and feedback. It's you, our players, who help shape the future of Drift Reign, and we are incredibly grateful. We look forward to seeing you on the track!

Best,
Midnight.Games.

notes.title: Mod support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43873587/52b8cc0de735a855fd16dd0f3dfc5273444db2ed.png[/img]

Prepare to Unleash Your Creativity: Mod Support is Coming Soon to Drift Reign!

We are excited to announce that a highly anticipated update is on the horizon for Drift Reign—Mod Support! Soon, you'll have the power to take your racing experience to new heights by customizing and expanding the game in ways you've only imagined.

With Mod Support, you'll be able to create your own tracks, design unique vehicles, and introduce game-altering features that will transform Drift Reign into your very own racing playground. Dive into the modding scene and join a passionate community of fellow enthusiasts who share your love for pushing the boundaries of creativity.

We understand the importance of providing user-friendly tools, which is why our development team has been hard at work to ensure that the modding experience in Drift Reign is accessible to all. Whether you're an experienced modder or just starting out, we've got you covered.

Stay tuned for the official release of the Mod Support update, where we'll be sharing more details, showcasing inspiring mods created by our community, and providing comprehensive guides to help you get started. This is your opportunity to shape the future of Drift Reign, leaving a lasting impact on the game's racing universe.

Get ready to rev your engines, because Mod Support is speeding its way towards Drift Reign. Prepare to ignite your creativity, push the boundaries of what's possible, and embark on an exhilarating journey of customization like never before. The countdown to the Mod Support update begins now!

Mod support through Steam Workshop.

notes.title: FREE UPDATE: 3 new cars + 1 new drift track

Are you ready to become the king of street drifting?

notes.title: Drift Reign

Experience the Thrill of Drift Reign! Gear up and join me for an adrenaline-fueled live stream as we hit the tracks in this exhilarating racing game. Get ready to feel the rush of the wind in your hair and the rumble of the engine as we navigate sharp turns, master hairpin bends, and unleash the full potential of our steering wheels. With realistic physics and stunning visuals, Drift Reign takes racing to a whole new level of immersion. Together, we'll fine-tune our skills, compete in intense races, and leave a trail of burnt rubber in our wake. Don't miss out on the heart-pounding action—join the live stream and get ready to dominate the race tracks in Drift Reign!
